title: IoT Air Quality Monitor
summary: A poultry sensor monitoring system connecting ESP32 readings to a searchable web dashboard.
contribution: Contributed database/filter error checks and merged backend and responsive UI changes. The verified error-check commit is co-authored with Copilot Autofix.
why: The strongest systems example: validated sensor input, isolated database transactions, authenticated routes, and tests for failure states.
limitations: Real collection has not started. No predictive AI or calibrated MQ gas concentrations; trusted-LAN configuration.

title: Morphism
summary: A coursework project for correcting Filipino–English code-switched text.
contribution: Added backend API/model test modules, dependency changes, CI configuration, and Docker setup in the public history.
why: Combines a web client, API, model artifacts, and assertion-based backend tests with documented setup.
limitations: README documents /api/process, while checked-in routes implement /predict. Model quality and live demo availability were not independently tested.

title: CrackTify
summary: A Python desktop coursework application for analyzing wall-crack images and managing detection records.
contribution: The public team matrix credits Joshua with digital image processing, AI training, and integration. Account-attributed history confirms merging the model-update pull request; this does not establish sole authorship.
why: Connects a Flet interface, TensorFlow Lite inference, OpenCV image annotation, and backend record-management routes. The repository documents architecture, setup, team roles, and manual testing.
limitations: Model accuracy and structural-safety suitability were not independently validated. Testing documentation describes manual UI-focused checks. The inspected image module contains a duplicate method definition; this is a coursework prototype.
